systems.name: InputSys
systems.summary: Emplaces the Input context variable and fills it each frame from the SDL event queue and window state.

systems.name: UISys
systems.summary: Feeds Input into ImGui's IO, starts the ImGui frame and masks mouse clicks ImGui captured.

systems.name: TimeSys
systems.summary: Legacy in-game calendar clock (Time context variable) with pause key, speed radio buttons and a frame-time window.

systems.name: PlayerControlSys
systems.summary: Emplaces the desktop Camera and flies it with WASD/Space/Ctrl and right-mouse look; R moves the VR play area under it.

systems.name: VRControlSys
systems.summary: VR stick locomotion and turning of the VRRig, right-trigger box throwing, and kinematic controller boxes following the hands.

systems.name: DebugMenuSys
systems.summary: ImGui 'Dynamical' window: frame time, camera, chunk counts, render toggles, physics stats, grass parameters, VR state.

systems.name: BoxRingSys
systems.summary: At init drops a ring of 12 dynamic boxes above the terrain around the origin (base scene).

systems.name: ModelLineupSys
systems.summary: At init lines up every glTF file of resources/models (except box.gltf) as a dynamic box-collider model (base scene).

systems.name: BoxThrowerSys
systems.summary: Left click (not captured by ImGui) throws a 1 m dynamic box from the desktop camera.

systems.name: WorldStepperSys
systems.summary: Steps the scene's Worlds in real time from the frame dt (fixed-step accumulator, max 8 ticks a frame) with a pause/step panel.

systems.name: FixedCameraSys
systems.summary: Places the desktop Camera once at init from JSON pos / look_at.

systems.name: SphereViewSys
systems.summary: Follow camera, velocity bars, rotation dots and an ImGui panel for one world's SphereAgent.

systems.name: RollerPlayerSys
systems.summary: Turns VR (stick or lean) or desktop (WASD) input into a steerSphere command for one world's sphere and puts the play area / camera on it.

systems.name: WorldViewSys
systems.summary: Mirrors the bodies and grounds of the worlds into host entities (Transform + ModelRenderable + WorldViewLink) so the renderer can draw them.

systems.name: Game
systems.summary: Owns the host registry, emplaces Settings/tf::Executor/RunArgs/FrameClock/Worlds, builds renderer and SystemSet from the scene, runs the frame loop.

systems.name: Capture
systems.summary: Capture script runner: injects scripted SDL input, moves the desktop Camera per shot, waits for terrain and writes PNGs.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Per-frame keyboard, mouse and window state of the desktop window.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by InputSys's constructor (so it exists as soon as the scene's host systems are built). InputSys rewrites it every frame from SDL events: action bits in `on` follow key down/up (they stay set while the key is held), click flags and wheel/motion deltas are reset at the start of InputSys::tick and are therefore valid for one frame. UISys consumes `text` and masks clicks/downs captured by ImGui. Several systems consume one-shot action bits by clearing them: TimeSys clears PAUSE, PlayerControlSys clears VR_RIG, Game::start clears EXIT. DebugMenuSys sets VR_RIG from a button. Not registered with the component registry; Game::start requires it (reg.ctx().get<Input>() after init), so every rendered scene must list the Input system.

fields.name: text
fields.desc: Last SDL_TEXTINPUT of the frame; consumed (reset) by UISys.

fields.name: on
fields.desc: Action bits. Mapped keys: W FORWARD, S BACKWARD, A LEFT, D RIGHT, P PAUSE, Space UP, LCtrl DOWN, LShift SPRINT, R VR_RIG, M MENU, K DEBUG, Backspace BACKSPACE, Left ROTATE_LEFT, Right ROTATE_RIGHT, Up ANGLE_UP, Down ANGLE_DOWN, Tab TAB. RESIZE set on window resize (never cleared by InputSys); EXIT set by SDL_QUIT or Escape.

fields.name: mousePos
fields.desc: Mouse position in window pixels, updated only while focused.

fields.name: mouseWheel
fields.desc: Wheel of the last SDL_MOUSEWHEEL event this frame (not summed).

fields.name: mouseDelta
fields.desc: Sum of relative mouse motion this frame.

fields.name: screenSize
fields.desc: SDL_GetWindowSize of the desktop window, each tick.

fields.name: mouseLeft / mouseRight / mouseMiddle
fields.desc: Raw button held state from SDL.

fields.name: leftDown / rightDown / middleDown
fields.desc: Button held state; UISys forces false while ImGui wants the mouse, else copies the raw state.

fields.name: leftClick / rightClick / middleClick
fields.desc: Button pressed this frame; UISys clears them while ImGui wants the mouse.

fields.name: focused
fields.desc: Window has keyboard focus (SDL focus gained/lost events).

fields.name: window_showing
fields.desc: False after minimize, true after restore.

components.name: Time
components.summary: Legacy in-game calendar clock in integer game seconds.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by TimeSys::preinit and only used by TimeSys. Game time advances by speed * speed_modifier * frame_dt * 10 game seconds per frame (truncated to uint64). The header also defines Date (calendar breakdown: 60 s, 60 min, 24 h, 28-day months, 4 months named Spring/Summer/Automn/Winter), which is not stored in a registry. Leftover of the archived tile-map simulation; nothing else reads it.

fields.name: current
fields.desc: Game seconds since start.

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: Game seconds per real second (before the x10 factor and the modifier).

fields.name: speed_modifier
fields.desc: 0 paused; radio buttons offer 0, 1, 3, 10, 50.

fields.name: last_speed_modifier
fields.desc: Last non-zero modifier, restored when unpausing with P.

fields.name: dt
fields.desc: Game seconds added this frame.

fields.name: minute / hour / day / month / year
fields.desc: Calendar constants.

components.name: ModelRenderable
components.summary: Draws the ModelC held by another entity at this entity's Transform, tinted.
components.description: Per-entity host component read by the renderer's ModelPass (view<const Transform, const ModelRenderable>). `model` is the entity returned by ModelManager::load / add, which holds the GPU ModelC. Emplaced by spawnBox (BoxRingSys, BoxThrowerSys, DebugMenuSys, VRControlSys), ModelLineupSys, VRControlSys (hands), SphereViewSys (bar and dot parts), WorldViewSys (world body mirrors) and the scene component `ModelRenderable` (register_view.cpp), which needs the renderer's ModelManager. Only meaningful in the host registry of dynamical (world registries use ModelRef instead).
components.scene_json: "ModelRenderable": { "path": "<file under resources/>", "tint": [r, g, b, a] (default [1,1,1,1]) }. Unknown keys throw (JsonFields::finish). Throws ComponentError if there is no ModelManager (no renderer) or the model cannot be loaded (/path). Saved back as { "tint": [...] } only (the path is not saved).

fields.name: model
fields.desc: Host entity holding the ModelC; entt::null draws nothing (renderer side).

fields.name: tint
fields.desc: RGBA multiplier.

components.name: WorldViewLink
components.summary: Marks a host entity created by WorldViewSys as the mirror of one shape of a world entity.
components.description: Emplaced by WorldViewSys::tick with Transform and ModelRenderable when a world body or ground is first seen; the host entity is destroyed when the source is no longer seen (or the model cannot be resolved), and all are destroyed in WorldViewSys::finish. WorldViewSys keeps its own map (world, entity) -> host entity and never reads this component back; it exists so other code can identify mirror entities.

fields.name: world
fields.desc: Index of the world in Worlds.

fields.name: entity
fields.desc: Source entity in that world's registry.

components.name: WorldStepperState
components.summary: Interpolation factor and pause state of the real-time world stepper.
components.description: Host context variable emplaced by WorldStepperSys::preinit and rewritten each tick (when worlds exist). alpha in [0, 1) is where the frame sits between the last two fixed ticks (1 when paused); WorldViewSys, SphereViewSys and RollerPlayerSys use it to interpolate PhysicsPose. paused/step_once are toggled by the stepper's own ImGui panel. Readers fall back to alpha = 1 when it is absent.

fields.name: alpha
fields.desc: accumulator / h after stepping, or 1 when paused.

fields.name: h
fields.desc: World 0's WorldClock::dt, refreshed each tick.

fields.name: paused
fields.desc: Panel checkbox; no real-time ticks while set.

fields.name: step_once
fields.desc: Panel Step button: pauses and runs exactly one tick on the next frame.

fields.name: ticks
fields.desc: Total ticks stepped by the stepper.

components.name: VRHands
components.summary: The two host entities drawing (and colliding as) the VR controllers.
components.description: Anonymous-namespace struct in vr_control.cpp, emplaced by VRControlSys::preinit. Filled in VRControlSys::init only when VRInput exists and is enabled and resources/models/box.gltf loads; each hand is then an entity with Transform (scale 0), ModelRenderable (box, blue left / red right) and a kinematic RigidBody of half extent 0.04. Not reachable from other translation units.

fields.name: hands
fields.desc: Left (0) and right (1) hand entities, entt::null when not created.

components.name: tf::Executor
components.description: Emplaced default-constructed (one worker per hardware thread) by Game's constructor. Used by ChunkGeneratorSys, TerrainColliders and the Renderer's parallel command recording. WorldStepperSys does not pass it to Worlds::step, so worlds step sequentially in dynamical. Defined by Taskflow, not by the engine.
